abilities.name: HinataAbility2

passives.desc: Every 3 RegularAttacks: - Create a Distortion on this unit's Target for 10 seconds  Enemies walking into Distortion will: - Disappear from the map for 2 seconds (12s Cooldown) - Take 50% of this unit's current damage  Enemies will not move while in Distortion.

passives.name: GriffithFemtoPassive2

Enemies inflicted with GriffithFemtoMark will take 5% increased damage from this unit.

passives.name: GriffithFemtoPassive3
passives.desc: For every GriffithFemtoMeter stack: - Increase the damage of this unit's Distortion by 5%  At 35 GriffithFemtoMeter stacks: - All enemies in range will take 100% of this unit's current damage per second for 5 seconds - After 5 seconds reset GriffithFemtoMeter back to 0

name: Alchemy Brothers (Truth)

passives.name: EdwardAlphonsePassive1
passives.desc: This unit’s attacks cycle through 3 attacks  Understand: On attack: - Apply AlchemyMark   (Capacity: 3) - AlchemyMark will not be removed through each rotation  Deconstruct: On attack: - Grants all units in range 5% Magical damage per AlchemyMark applied   (Capacity: 50% Magical damage)   For 10 seconds  Reconstruct: On attack: - Deal 120% of this unit’s current damage - Apply 70% Slow for 6 seconds

passives.name: EdwardAlphonsePassive2

passives.desc: If the majority of your team have a damaging DoT: - Those units can apply 2 more stack of their DoT to the enemy  If the majority of your team have no damaging DoT: - This units AlchemyMark capacity is increased by 3 - Understand from EdwardAlphonsePassive1 applies an extra AlchemyMark  If there is no majority: - Deconstruct’s Magical damage bonus is increased by 10% - Reconstruct’s Slow is increased by 10% Excludes all Farms

On CriticalAttack: - Increase GokuMeter by 10 If this unit is Debuffed or Stun: - Increase GokuMeter by 20 At 30 GokuMeter stacks: - Transform this unit into GokuTransformation In GokuTransformation form: - Apply Stagger to all enemies in range - This unit becomes immune to StatusEffects - Increase Damage by 15% - Increase Crit Damage by 20% - GokuMeter will decrease by 1 every 2 seconds When GokuMeter is depleted: - Transform back into base

passives.name: ZerefPassive3

name: Dead Melody (Solo)

passives.name: BrookPassive1
passives.desc: To units in range with the Unbound trait: - +15% Damage - +5% Range To units in range without the Unbound trait: - +30% Damage - +10% Range  The first OnePieceCategory unit placed in this unit's range is designated as the BrookCaptain The BrookCaptain gains: - +20% Critical Chance - +25% Critical Damage If the BrookCaptain is removed from the map: - Designate the closest OnePieceCategory unit as the BrookCaptain  Summoned units and clones do not receive these buffs directly and cannot become the BrookCaptain.

passives.name: BrookPassive2
passives.desc: This unit can switch between two melodies. Any enemy that enters this area is afflicted with DeepFreeze for 3s. When this unit attacks an enemy within this area: - Extend DeepFreeze duration by 1s (Extension Cap: 1)  If this unit attacks an enemy afflicted with DeepFreeze: - Deals an additional instance of 30% damage to hit enemies

Every 15s: - Inflict the 5 strongest enemies on the map with Hypnosis

passives.desc: Every 30 seconds: - TimeStop all enemies in range for 10 seconds (Maximum 3 times per enemy) During TimeStop: - This unit applies Fire on attack - Fire deals 2% increased damage per tick (Capacity: 20%) - All currently applied DoT have their durations paused until TimeStop ends (Enemies can be afflicted by additional DoT during this)

passives.name: ShoPassive2
passives.desc: During TimeStop, enemies inflicted by this unit's Fire     - Spread an instance of Fire to 3 of the closest enemies When TimeStop ends, enemies which had Fire spread onto them    - Take damage equal to 15% of the damage dealt by this unit during TimeStop

passives.name: ShoPassive3
passives.desc: For every enemy killed with TimeStop applied: - Increases TimeStop duration by 1 second - Gain a stack of FlameFeather (Capacity: 10) On next TimeStop activation: - Consume all FlameFeather stacks For each stack consumed, this unit’s next attack: - Applies an instance of Fire per consumed stack

name: Hollow (Blaze)

passives.name: GabimaruPassive1
passives.desc: If an enemy with Fire stops ticking within this unit's range: - Convert 1 Fire application into AustereFlames dealing 65% of this unit's current damage - Instance of AustereFlames from GabimaruPassive1 do not stack

passives.name: GabimaruPassive2
passives.desc: If this unit Attacks an enemy that currently has Fire applied: - Convert 1 Fire application into AustereFlames dealing 65% of this unit's current damage - Instance of AustereFlames from GabimaruPassive2 do not stack

name: Ignition Commander (Betrayal)

passives.name: BurnsPassive1
passives.desc: Whenever an enemy is within 60% of this unit's range, they enter BurnsZone1 Enemies within BurnsZone1: - Gain 1 HeatStack per second until they leave this unit's range (Capacity: 10 Stacks) Whenever an enemy is within 30% of this unit's range, they enter BurnsZone2 - Enemies within BurnsZone2 are given: - Stun for 2 seconds After Stun expires: - Apply Rewind for 7 distance - Can only happen once per enemy If the same enemy enters BurnsZone2 again: - Gain 2 HeatStack per second until they leave BurnsZone2 If Rewind takes an enemy outside this unit's range: - The enemy does not lose their current HeatStack

passives.name: BurnsPassive2
passives.desc: For each HeatStack applied to an enemy, this unit deals: - 3% increased damage to that enemy per HeatStack  When an enemy reaches 10 HeatStack: - This unit applies Fire to that enemy

passives.name: BurnsPassive3
passives.desc: When Rewind is applied from BurnsPassive1: - Deal 75% damage to all enemies within BurnsZone1   15 second cooldown When an enemy reaches the HeatStack capacity from BurnsPassive1: - BurnsPassive3 deals 15% increase damage to them

name: Iron Wolf (Struggler)

passives.name: GutsPassive1
passives.desc: Each hit of an attack from this unit will apply Bleed  Every hit from a RegularAttack from this unit will: - Deal the remaining total damage of all Bleed stacks on the enemy instantly as TrueDamage - Remove all Bleed stacks on the enemy

passives.name: GutsPassive2
passives.desc: When an enemy that have been inflicted with Bleed at least 1 time dies: - Leave 1 GutsSpill on the ground for 6 seconds  GutsSpill will apply 1 stack of Bleed every 5 seconds. Only 2 non-permanent GutsSpill may exist at a time.

passives.name: GutsPassive3
passives.desc: If 2 GutsSpill overlap, they will combine into 1 GutsSpill.  Each time GutsSpill combines: - Add 4 seconds to its despawn timer - Increase its radius by 15%  When a GutsSpill combines 10 times: - The GutsSpill becomes permanent  Permanent GutsSpill's cannot combine. Only 2 permanent GutsSpill may exist at a time.

name: Kitsune

passives.name: SparklePassive1
passives.desc: This unit has SkillPoints, starting at 0. On RegularAttack: - Gain 1 SkillPoint (Capacity: 3)

passives.name: SparklePassive2
passives.desc: When this unit has a SkillPoint, instead of attacking, the strongest unit in range: - Decrease SPA by 15% for 10 seconds - Increase Attack Speed by 15% for 10 seconds If SparklePassive2 is already applied to selected unit: - Apply to the next strongest unit instead

passives.name: SparklePassive3
passives.desc: This unit has SparkleMeter, starting at 0. On RegularAttack or when buffing a unit: - Increase SparkleMeter by 20 (Capacity: 100) At SparkleMeter reaching capacity: - Unlock SparkleAbility1

abilities.name: SparkleAbility1
abilities.display: The Hero with a Thousand Faces
abilities.desc: On activation: - Set SkillPoints to max capacity - Decrease this unit's SPA by 15% until SkillPoints are at 0 - Increase every unit's damage in range by 35% for 30 seconds

name: Noble Captain (Vibrant)

passives.name: ByakuyaPassive1
passives.desc: This unit deals +25% more damage to enemies with Movespeed-related Modifiers.  When an enemy is inflicted with HardCC, this unit will: - FollowUpAttack on that enemy with Byakuya_Skill2 for 25% of this unit's damage (Local Cooldown: 7s)

passives.name: ByakuyaPassive2
passives.desc: When this unit attacks an enemy afflicted with Dismember, gains: - +15% Damage - +5% Range If Dismember was applied by a BleachCategory unit, instead gains: - +30% Damage - +10% Range

abilities.name: ByakuyaAbility2
abilities.desc: On activation: - Select a spot within this unit's range to Relocate to - Immediately FollowUpAttack with Byakuya_Skill2, targeting the Fastest enemy, inflicting Stagger for 2s

abilities.name: ByakuyaAbility1
abilities.desc: On activation: - This unit lets go of its sword and switches into ByakuyaTransformation  ByakuyaTransformation: - Gains ByakuyaPassive3 - Gains ByakuyaAbility3 - Loses Physical & gains Magical - Switches to Byakuya_Skill3 - Becomes unsellable

name: Prodigy (Rage)

passives.name: GohanPassive1
passives.desc: On Upgrade 3: - Transform into GohanTransformation - Every 4 RegularAttacks will deal 25% of this unit's damage to all enemies within its range On Upgrade 5: - Unlock GohanPassive3

passives.name: GohanPassive2
passives.desc: On RegularAttack against an enemy with a StatusEffect: - Deal 10% increased damage per stack of each StatusEffect (Cap: 100%) If the StatusEffect is a DoT: - Refresh the duration - Change the source to this unit - This can only trigger once per DoT type per enemy

passives.name: GohanPassive3
passives.desc: This unit has GohanMeter, starting at 0. On RegularAttack: - Increase GohanMeter by 5 When enemies leave this unit's range: - Increase GohanMeter by 1 At 100 GohanMeter stacks: - Remove GohanMeter - Transform this unit into GohanTransformation2 In GohanTransformation2 form: - Increase this unit's damage by 25% - Every 3 RegularAttacks will deal 75% of this unit's damage to all enemies within its range

abilities.name: GohanAbility1
abilities.desc: On activation: - Select a point within this unit's range to fire GohanAbility1 at for 10 seconds Enemies in GohanAbility1 will: - Take 75% of this unit's damage every 1 seconds This unit will not Attack whilst this ability is active.

name: Reaper (Frenzied)

passives.name: IchigoVastoPassive1
passives.desc: When an enemy leaves this unit’s range: - Perform IchigoVasto_Skill1 on that enemy for 200% damage (Cooldown: 8s) If the enemy survives that attack: - Apply 50% Slow to that enemy for 10 seconds

passives.name: IchigoVastoPassive2
passives.desc: When this unit is afflicted with a StatusEffect: - Cleanses itself & perform IchigoVasto_Skill4 for 150% of its damage - This attack hits all enemies in range & applies Stun for 3s Cooldown: 5s

passives.name: IchigoVastoPassive3
passives.desc: When a Boss leaves this unit’s range: - This unit stops attacking and becomes a PathSummon, grabbing the Boss and dragging them along the path back to the closest spot on the track near this unit’s position (Global Cooldown: 30s) - The Boss takes 200% of this unit’s damage from the initial grab, guaranteed to crit - Every enemy hit by the PathSummon takes 150% of this unit’s damage Max application per Boss: 1

abilities.name: IchigoVastoAbility1
abilities.desc: Select a unit within this unit’s range. On activation: - This unit pins that unit to the ground and performs IchigoVasto_Skill2 aimed at the unit - Stuns that unit for 8 seconds - All enemies in range of the attack are hit for 300% damage

name: Sand (Alligator)

passives.name: CrocodilePassive1
passives.desc: CrocodilePassive1 appears at this unit's location CrocodilePassive1 will: - Increase 5% in size every 1 seconds (Capacity: 100%) - Apply Sandstorm to enemies inside After CrocodilePassive1 has been at 100% for 7 seconds: - Reset CrocodilePassive1 size to 10%

passives.name: CrocodilePassive2
passives.desc: This unit's Poison will: - Deal 15% increased damage per tick If an enemy is inside CrocodilePassive1 or CrocodileAbility1: - Poison will deal 25% increased damage per tick (Capacity: 150%) When CrocodilePassive1 reaches 20% range: - Apply extra stack of Poison while the enemy remains inside

abilities.name: CrocodileAbility1
abilities.desc: On activation: - CrocodilePassive1 will increase 10% in size every 1 seconds (Capacity: 100%) This unit will not Attack whilst this ability is active. If CrocodileAbility1 is re-triggered before 100% range is reached: - Slow enemies in CrocodileAbility1 by 65% - Deal 125% of this unit's current damage to all enemies in range If CrocodileAbility1 reaches 100% range: - Stun enemies in CrocodileAbility1 for 5 seconds - Deal 200% of this unit's current damage to all enemies in range

name: Shadow (Divine)

passives.name: MegumiPassive1
passives.desc: On Upgrade 3: - Summon a WingedSpirit at this unit's position that will circle at 50% of this unit's range - WingedSpirit will deal 50% of this unit's current damage every 8 seconds in its current location and apply Stun

passives.name: MegumiPassive2
passives.desc: On Upgrade 5: - Summon a WolfSpirit at this unit's position - WolfSpirit can be upgraded independently

abilities.name: MegumiAbility1
abilities.desc: On activation: - Transform the whole map into ShadowRealm ShadowRealm will: - ShadowRewind all enemies in range for 50% of this unit's range - Apply 25% Damage Buff to all Magical units for 30 seconds ShadowRewind can be applied to an enemy a maximum of 2 times.

abilities.name: MegumiAbility2
abilities.desc: On activation: - Summon DivineSpirit - Stun this unit for 15 seconds  - DivineSpirit's damage will be equal to 100% of this unit's base damage DivineSpirit cannot despawn, be killed or stunned.

name: Sharkfang (Abyssal)

passives.name: HarribelPassive1
passives.desc: Every 12 seconds: - Summon HarribelPassive1 at the end of this unit's range moving towards spawn HarribelPassive1 will: - Slow enemies hit by 35% - Deal 15% of this unit's current damage

passives.name: HarribelPassive2
passives.desc: When HarribelPassive1 or HarribelAbility1 despawn: - Summon HarribelVaporCloud at that location for 5 seconds While an enemy is inside of HarribelVaporCloud: - Apply Fire - Fire from HarribelVaporCloud can stack - Deal 15% of this unit's current damage every 1 seconds

abilities.name: HarribelAbility1
abilities.desc: On activation: - Summon 2 instances of HarribelAbility1 from the end of this unit's range moving towards enemy spawn HarribelAbility1 will: - Apply Rewind to enemies hit for 10 distance - Deal 50% of this unit's current damage

name: Sovereign (Djinn)

passives.name: SinbadPassive1
passives.desc: When no Boss is in this unit's range: - SinbadPassive2 is active When a Boss is in this unit's range: - SinbadPassive3 is active - Does not deactivate SinbadPassive2

passives.name: SinbadPassive2
passives.desc: While active: - Each attack creates 5 chains - Each chain deals 25% of this unit's current damage - Chains bounce between enemies If there are fewer than 5 enemies: - Chains bounce between the existing enemies If there's only 1 enemy: - All chains hit the same enemy

passives.name: SinbadPassive3
passives.desc: While active: - Increase Damage by 50% - Attacks apply Freeze - This unit auto targets the boss After Freeze effect wears off: - Permanently slow the enemy by 15% (Can’t stack)

passives.name: SinbadPassive4
passives.desc: Every 7 seconds summon a LightningStrike on the strongest enemy in this unit's range: - LightningStrike deals 75% of this unit's damage - LightningStrike will chain between 3 enemies - Each chain deals 20% of this unit's current damage - Each chain will also apply Freeze

name: The Drink (Juicebox)

passives.name: TrunksPassive1
passives.desc: Every 6 RegularAttacks: - Inflict enemies with TrunksMark for 15 seconds TrunksMark will: - Increase all FollowUpAttack damage by 10% - Apply a Physical weakness at 10%

passives.name: TrunksPassive2
passives.desc: When a FollowUpAttack happens in this unit's range (Cooldown: 8s): - FollowUpAttack at 150% of this unit's current damage - Apply TrunksPassive1

passives.name: TrunksPassive3
passives.desc: On applying TrunksMark during TrunksTransformation: - All FollowUpAttacks from this unit will critically strike and deal 15% increased critical damage

abilities.name: TrunksAbility1
abilities.desc: On activation: - This unit will transform into TrunksTransformation for 60 seconds - Decreases TrunksPassive1 attacks required by 1 - Increases TrunksPassive2 FollowUpAttack damage by 15% - Decrease SPA by 10% - Increase RNG by 10%

name: Water Sage (Founder)

passives.name: TobiramaPassive1
passives.desc: Every 15 seconds: - Spawn a MirrorClone within this unit's range (Capacity: 3) MirrorClone: - Has 10% of this unit's current damage - Disappears after 3 attacks For each MirrorClone spawned by this unit that is currently on the map: - Increase this unit's damage by 10% - Increase this unit's range by 10%

passives.name: TobiramaPassive2
passives.desc: The attacks of this unit and its MirrorClone both always do a FollowUpAttack respectively.  FollowUpAttacks from this unit and its MirrorClone will : - Deal 120% of this unit's current damage

passives.name: TobiramaPassive3
passives.desc: This unit has a StormFlashMeter, starting at 0. (Capacity : 3) Every 5 FollowUpAttacks from this unit or a MirrorClone will : - Increase StormFlashMeter by 1. When the closest allied unit in this unit's range is stunned : - Consume 1 StormFlashMeter stacks - Cleanse the Stun

passives.name: TobiramaPassive4
passives.desc: Whenever a FollowUpAttack happens in this unit's range: - Place a BombTag where this enemy was hit (Capacity : 5) BombTag : - Acts as a PathTrap When an enemy is hit by BombTag : - Deal 25% of this unit's current damage to that enemy. - Decrease this unit's SPA by 1% (Capacity : 5%)

name: Wild Card (Ace)

passives.name: JokerPassive1
passives.desc: When this unit is placed: - All FireDoT gain 2 ticks over 2 seconds When a unit hits an enemy affected by their own FireDoT: - Refresh 1 of that unit's FireDoT on that enemy - Each FireDoT can only be refreshed once by JokerPassive1

passives.name: JokerPassive2
passives.desc: Every attack rotates between JokerPassive2 effects:  Jack: - The enemy's FireDoT deals 15% increased damage for 5 seconds  Queen: - Reapply 1 FireDoT on the enemy based on 60% of this unit's damage  King: - Apply Fire for 6 ticks over 6 seconds - Deal 75% of this unit's current damage  Joker: - Apply Jack, Queen, and King  Queen and King cannot create more than 1 FireDoT from this unit on the same enemy.

passives.name: JokerPassive3
passives.desc: Every 5 attacks: - Apply all JokerPassive2 effects at double efficiency - Does not advance the JokerPassive2 rotation Each time this effect activates: - Increase this unit's Fire damage by 5%   (Capacity: 50%)

name: Atom (Totality)

passives.name: CidPassive1
passives.desc: All buffs applied from this passive last 15 seconds and do not stack. When this unit attacks a Basic enemy: - +15% Damage When this unit attacks an Elite: - +40% Critical Chance When this unit attacks a Boss: - Counts as attacking a Basic and an Elite - +10% Range - +20% Critical Damage

passives.name: CidPassive2
passives.desc: When Boss enters range: - That Boss receives +100% Damage Dealt for 10s After 10s have passed: - That Boss is dealt an instance of damage for 300% of this unit's damage - All enemies in range are dealt an instance of damage for 100% of this unit's damage  Per-Player Cooldown: 60s

passives.name: CidPassive3
passives.desc: After attacking the same enemy 3 times with basic attacks, inflict that enemy with Radiation: - Radiation: Deals 10% of this unit's damage in 7 ticks over 14s - Non-Boss enemies afflicted with Radiation will be executed at or below 5% health  On basic attack against an enemy afflicted with Radiation: - Increase the damage factor of existing Radiation on that enemy by +20% (Up to +100%) If this unit is the source of the Radiation: - Refresh the duration of Radiation on that enemy

abilities.name: CidAbility1
abilities.desc: On activation: - Remove any existing Radiation stacks from enemies - Starting at 500% of this unit's damage, each stack of Radiation removed will increase this ability's damage by +10% (Bonus Cap: 500%) - Charges for 8s before firing - This ability will hit every enemy on the map and bypass all mechanics

name: Crimson Captain (Moon)

passives.name: BenimaruPassive1
passives.desc: If an enemy is within this unit's range: - Gain 1 Scorched stack every 3 seconds (Capacity : 10) Enemies afflicted with Scorched will : - Take 10% increased damage from FireElement units - Take 20% increased damage from any FireDoT For every FireElement unit placed or unique stack of FireDoT on an enemy in this unit's range: - Increase damage by 5% (Capacity : 25%) - Increase buffs from Scorched by 2% (Capacity : 10%)

passives.name: BenimaruPassive2
passives.desc: When an enemy has the maximum amount of Scorched stacks currently applied to them: - This unit's FireDoT will always critically strike on that enemy Each enemy with max Scorched stacks in this unit's range will: - Increase this unit's critical damage by 5% (Capacity: 50%)

passives.name: BenimaruPassive3
passives.desc: Every 10 seconds: - Spawn a FireBanner next to this unit (Capacity: 5) FireBanner will : - Deal 15% of this unit's current damage - Have a fixed SPA of 5 - Have 75% of this unit's current range - Apply their own instance of FireDoT Once 5 FireBanner have been spawned by this unit : - Spawn FireBanner from the base as summons FireBanner Summons will : - Deal 20% of this unit's current damage when passing through an enemy - Summons do not lose HP when passing through enemies

abilities.name: BenimaruAbility1
abilities.display: Seventh Form, Wheel of the Sun
abilities.desc: On activation: - Deal 250% damage to all enemies in range - Apply Fire dealing 100% Damage per tick to all enemies in range

name: Crow (Black Fire)

passives.name: ItachiPassive1
passives.desc: On RegularAttack: Apply Illusion for 12 seconds

passives.name: ItachiPassive2
passives.desc: While an enemy is in Illusion state: - Store all damage taken from this unit When Illusion expires: - Deal stored damage at 25% effectiveness in a small AoE (2 range)

passives.name: ItachiPassive3
passives.desc: - BlackFire damage shields every tick - Enemies with shields within this unit's range gain a stack of BlackFire

name: Devil (Hero)

passives.name: ShinraPassive1
passives.desc: Every 20 seconds: - This unit's next attack applies a DemonHead radius on an enemy for 10 seconds Enemies inside DemonHead's radius: - Take 10% increased damage from this unit DemonHead: - When this unit attacks an enemy inside its radius, apply 1 instance of EnhancedBurn - EnhancedBurn deals 75% damage in 4 ticks over 4 seconds - Stores all EnhancedBurn damage dealt while active

passives.name: ShinraPassive2
passives.desc: This unit has DemonMeter, starting at 0. (Capacity: 20) While an enemy is affected by DemonHead: - Gain 1 DemonMeter every second For each DemonMeter: - Decrease SPA by 1% - Increase Attack Speed by 1%

passives.name: ShinraPassive3
passives.desc: When DemonHead expires: - Detonate in a small radius - Apply Fire - Deal 50% of all stored EnhancedBurn damage When DemonMeter is full: - Deal 15% of this unit's current damage as extra damage - Reset DemonMeter

name: Head Captain (Char)

passives.name: YamamotoPassive2
passives.desc: Fire applied by this unit can stack infinitely. Fire deals 5% more damage for each stack of Fire on enemies within this unit's range (Capacity: 150%)

passives.name: YamamotoPassive1
passives.desc: When an enemy enters this unit's range: - Apply Fire If the enemy entering this unit's range has a Shield: - Apply an additional stack of Fire that can Pierce

passives.name: YamamotoPassive3
passives.desc: On Takedown within this unit's range: - Transform the enemy into a YamamotoSkeleton (Capacity: 3) Each YamamotoSkeleton will act as a PathTrap: - When touched by an enemy, deal 25% of this unit's current damage - Explode and apply Fire to enemies within 3 range Each YamamotoSkeleton summoned will: - Increase this unit's damage by 5%

abilities.name: YamamotoAbility1
abilities.desc: On activation: - Deal 200% of this unit's current damage to all enemies in range - Deal an additional 100% damage divided among all enemies in range

name: Impaler (Ultimate)

passives.name: AlucardPassive1
passives.desc: This unit has two attack modes to switch between. Select a mode at the top of this unit's Upgrade UI.  Custom Arms "Piety": - -35% SPA - +50% Damage - On attack: Inflicts Bleed for 50% damage over 6 seconds to any enemy type except Boss  Anti-Freak "Obliteration": - +35% SPA - +100% Damage - +20% Range - On attack: Inflicts Bleed for 100% damage over 12 seconds to any enemy type except Basic, and deal 50% more damage

passives.name: AlucardPassive2
passives.desc: All Bleed and Bleed​-related PathTraps that exist in this unit's range have their source changed to this unit. All Bleed that is sourced from this unit is enhanced, increasing its damage factor by 10%, and cannot be affected by other units.  All Bleed​-related PathTraps in this unit's range have their properties enhanced: - Radius increased by 100% - Duration increased by 10s - Damage increased by 100%  On attacking an enemy afflicted with Bleed: - This unit will consume all Bleed stacks, increasing their tick rate to instantly complete - If this unit consumes Bleed stacks, for both this unit and the unit whom originally applied the stack, +25% Damage

passives.name: AlucardPassive3
passives.desc: This unit can regenerate from any StatusEffect and Debuff, decreasing their duration by 99%. This unit has built-in access to Relocation. On usage: - Transform into mist, instantly relocating to the selected position - Disable Unit Moving for 30 seconds  For PathSummons created by this unit, spawn at the end of its range. When this unit gets a kill: - Summon a AlucardVampire for 15% of this unit's damage (Cap: 3) If this unit gets a takedown instead: - Summon a AlucardGhoul for 5% of this unit's damage (Cap: 6)

abilities.name: AlucardAbility1
abilities.desc: You are the Commander.   On activation: - Speak the command: Search & Destroy - Opens this unit's Cadaver Domain for 10s - Performs AlucardEVO_Skill3 for 1000% damage  Cadaver Domain: All enemies on the map are afflicted with Burdened for the duration of the ability - Burdened immobilizes enemies and bypasses all lockouts without applying a lockout of its own

name: Rainman (Forecast)

passives.name: WeatherPassive1
passives.desc: This unit has WeatherMeter, starting at 0. Every hit from WeatherAbility1: - Increase WeatherMeter by 5 When WeatherMeter is at 100: - WeatherAbility1 turns into WeatherPassive2

passives.name: WeatherPassive2
passives.desc: Every 1 seconds: - Decrease WeatherMeter by 20 When an enemy comes within 5 range of WeatherPassive2: - Enemy will stop moving for 5 seconds If an enemy dies in WeatherPassive2: - Enemy is converted into a WeatherFrog When WeatherMeter is emptied: - WeatherPassive2  turns into WeatherAbility1

passives.name: WeatherPassive3
passives.desc: WeatherFrogs are a stationary path summon. If an enemy walks over WeatherFrog: - WeatherFrog will explode for 100% of this unit's current damage and apply Poison in 3 range

abilities.name: WeatherAbility1
abilities.desc: Select a position within this unit's range to summon WeatherAbility1 Enemies within WeatherAbility1 will: - Take damage equal to 15% of this unit's damage every 1 seconds

name: Wolf (Revived)

passives.name: StarrkPassive1
passives.desc: This unit’s base SPA cannot go lower than 1s. This unit’s attacks ignore animation lock.  On Attack: - Forcibly performs StarrkEVO_Skill1 - Increase SPA by +50% for every attack performed in the cycle  On 5th Attack: - Perform current attack instead of StarrkEVO_Skill1 - Reset SPA to 0%

passives.name: StarrkPassive2
passives.desc: On the 5th Attack of StarrkPassive1 and for that attack only: - Increase AOE Size by +50%  - Increase Damage by +100% - This attack has infinite range.

passives.name: StarrkPassive3
passives.desc: On the 5th Attack of each cycle performed through StarrkPassive1: - Spawn 2 StarrkWolves (Capacity: 3)  StarrkWolf: - Spawns next to this unit’s position - Has 15% of this unit’s damage  - Applies ManaBurn for 15% of its damage  On Attack: - StarrkWolf deletes itself

abilities.name: StarrkAbility1
abilities.desc: This unit stops attacking for 5s. After 5s: - Performs a modified version of StarrkEVO_Skill3 that fires constantly for 8s, dealing 65% of this unit’s damage per second - Inflicts ManaBurn for 100% at 6 ticks over 6 seconds - This ability always crits and is treated with the same effects as the 5th attack of StarrkPassive1

name: Jester

passives.name: KitePassive1
passives.desc: At the start of a wave or after 20 seconds swap to random weapon: - KitePassive2 - KitePassive3 - KitePassive4

passives.name: KitePassive2
passives.desc: When swapped to: - Release a Full AoE attack - Increase Damage by 25% On normal attack: - Release a slash in a Cone that continues travelling beyond this unit's range

passives.name: KitePassive3
passives.desc: When swapped to: - Continuously shoot in a Line for 3 seconds - Apply Bleed - Decrease SPA by 25% On normal attack: - Release a Line AoE attack - Apply Bleed

passives.name: KitePassive4
passives.desc: When swapped to: - Spawn a clone of this unit for 15 seconds - The clone will roll between Scythe and Rifle - Instantly roll again Roll 3 has a 30 second cooldown

passives.name: KitePassive5
passives.desc: If the same weapon is rolled 2 times in a row: - Activate Bored Jester Bored Jester: - Reduce the Jester Roll timer by 5 seconds - Increase the current weapon's damage by 25% - Prevent the current weapon from being rolled again

name: Lightning God (Overcharged)

passives.name: EnelPassive1
passives.desc: This unit has EnelMeter, starting at 0. Applies Electricity on hit to the 10 strongest enemies. Every time a Stun is activated from Electricity: - Increase EnelMeter by 1 (Capacity: 60) For each point in the meter: - Increase this units Electricity damage dealt by 5%

passives.name: EnelPassive2
passives.desc: At 25 EnelMeter stacks: - Summon EnelCloud within this unit's range every 10 seconds EnelCloud will: - Target a random enemy within this unit's range - Deal 25% of this unit's damage in 5 range If EnelCloud attacks an enemy without Electricity applied: - Apply an additional stack of Electricity

passives.name: EnelPassive3
passives.desc: At 60 EnelMeter stacks: - Summon a LightningStrike at this unit's position - Reset EnelMeter On LightningStrike: - Deal 100% of this unit's current damage and apply Electricity to all enemies in this unit's range - Leave ElectricResidue on the ground that will despawn after 8 seconds ElectricResidue will: - Keep Electricity permanently active on enemy until enemy has left range or it has despawned

passives.name: EnelPassive4
passives.desc: Every 10 seconds: - Apply Golden to 2 enemies in range Golden will: - Stun an enemy for 3 seconds - Increase chain lightning hits from Electricity to an additional 2 enemies

abilities.name: EnelAbility1
abilities.desc: On activation: - Select position in this unit's range for EnelCloud to target
